rationale: CR-001 resolved: blur() is now guarded by `if (e.detail > 0)`, correctly scoping the dismiss behavior to pointer/mouse clicks only (e.detail > 0) and preserving keyboard focus on Enter/Space activation (e.detail === 0). Tests updated with explicit detail values; keyboard non-blur case is now covered. No new issues introduced by the fix-up diff.

finding_status.notes: Guard `if (e.detail > 0)` applied exactly per recommendation. Test updated with detail:1 for pointer and detail:0 for keyboard; new keyboard test asserts blur not called.

business_review.text: Copy button appears when user hovers over a Markdown table in assistant output.
business_review.rationale: Pre-existing group-hover:opacity-100 CSS on the overlay div is unchanged by the diff.

business_review.text: After clicking the Copy button, table content is copied as expected.
business_review.rationale: copyToClipboard(raw.trim(), 'Table copied to clipboard') is still called first in the handler, before blur().

business_review.text: Copy button is hidden when the pointer leaves the table/button hover area.
business_review.rationale: blur() releases focus-within; once the pointer leaves, group-hover also deactivates, restoring opacity-0.

business_review.text: Copy button does not remain visible until an additional click.
business_review.rationale: The root cause (focus retention keeping focus-within active) is eliminated by the blur() call.

business_review.text: Existing message/table copy functionality is not broken.
business_review.rationale: Change is strictly additive — same copyToClipboard call with same arguments; no other copy paths affected.
